#Annalie_Outside.face.suprised
You: Ah, excuse me.
Who that might be? Not many people know this number.
#Annalie_Outside.face.normal
Bot: Where are you? It’s been almost two hours. Your walks are usually much shorter.
You: Sorry about that.
Bot: What is it? I can hear other voices in the background. Don’t tell me…
You: I’m going home already, don’t worry!
You: Sorry, I gotta go. Can I leave you two here?
Lady Annalie: Don’t worry, we are adults! Besides, I wouldn’t want you to get in trouble because of us~
Melissa: Our time was cut short because of me. I have no right to blame you.
You: Thanks! Bye!
